corridorId.description: Target corridor identifier (e.g. richmond_hq_i95, nova_i66_haymarket, ncr_fort_belvoir_dod, hampton_roads_naval).

radiusMiles.description: Catchment or operational radius in miles (e.g. 25, 50, 100).

insightLayer.description: Telemetry layer to synthesize (e.g. commercial_catchment_roi, sdvosb_dod_proximity, logistics_3d_tiles_kml).
